scene_report.narration_text: In Hindu mythology, the demon Bhasmasura performed intense prayers to please Lord Shiva.
Impressed by his devotion, Shiva granted the demon a terrifying boon.
Bhasmasura received the power to turn anyone into ashes simply by touching their head.
The demon immediately turned his sights on Shiva, forcing the god to flee for his life.
scene_report.main_action: lying in the dirt on a path

scene_report.narration_text: Lord Vishnu intervened with a plan, transforming into the beautiful enchantress Mohini.
Captivated by her, Bhasmasura agreed to a dance challenge where he had to mimic her every move.
scene_report.main_action: resting on a polished wooden floor

scene_report.narration_text: Mohini eventually placed her hand upon her own head while dancing.
scene_report.main_action: touching the top of a head

scene_report.narration_text: Without thinking, Bhasmasura copied the gesture and instantly turned himself into ashes.
This story highlights a dramatic irony where the demon's ultimate power became his own undoing.
He sought to destroy the universe but ended up destroying only himself.
